findings.acquisition: Parallel Quest 97 — Insidious Plot; current PQ reward references place Phantom Fist in Basic Rewards.
findings.mechanics: Defensive afterimage-style counter/evasion: when an attack connects, the user vanishes and reappears while recovering stamina. Current Xenoverse 2-specific reference documents roughly 100 stamina recovery; older player reports document activation-delay and balance behavior, so exact timing/repeat behavior remains version-sensitive.
findings.character_context: Used by Mira, Hit, Masked Saiyan, Yamcha (Supervillain), and Frost; later Partner Customization endpoints are documented.

evidence_limits: Exact activation/frame windows and repeat-use behavior are version-sensitive and not promoted as canonical numeric data.
No Ultimate Finish dependency established; current PQ97 Basic Reward listings do not require one.
result: P1 provenance verification complete; research-layer record enriched and canonical record retained without promotion.
